response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length >= 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_length IS NULL, avg_length DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Long film' means length >= 112 minutes (112 is the cutoff and is included). Films with NULL length are excluded by the filter.
Averages are computed per language_id as stored on film (not original_language_id), and only languages having at least one long film appear.

alternatives.interpretation: Long film means strictly longer than 112 minutes (length > 112)
